ZstdSharp.Port 0.8.5 (MIT), the pure managed Zstandard port: https://github.com/oleg-st/ZstdSharp
Only lib\net462\ZstdSharp.dll is vendored. The KSP client loads it late-bound (LmpCommon\PersistentSync\ZstdBackend.cs),
decompression only: the client's Unsafe 4.5.3 / System.Memory 4.5.4 are older than ZstdSharp's build references, which
decompression tolerates and compression does not. KSP's Managed folder has no netstandard.dll, so the net462 build is used.

System.Threading.Tasks.Extensions.dll (4.5.4, MIT, lib\net461 build, copied from External\Nuget) sits next to it because
ZstdSharp's async stream types reference it and KSP has no copy: without it KSP's add-on checker pops up "ZstdSharp failed
to load: missing System.Threading.Tasks.Extensions" on every launch. The net461 build only references mscorlib and the
Unsafe 4.0.4.1 the client already ships; the netstandard2.0 build would need netstandard.dll, which KSP lacks.
